question_vi: Phân biệt Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB) và Gateway Load Balancer. Khi nào dùng loại nào?
question_en: What is the difference between Application Load Balancer (ALB), Network Load Balancer (NLB), and Gateway Load Balancer? When do you use each?
answer_vi:
ALB cho Layer-7 HTTP routing; NLB cho Layer-4 high-perf TCP/UDP; GWLB cho virtual network appliances.

Application Load Balancer (ALB) hoạt động ở Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS), hỗ trợ content-based routing (theo host header, path, query string, HTTP method, headers), WebSocket, HTTP/2, gRPC; tích hợp Cognito authentication, WAF, Lambda target; phù hợp cho web application, microservices, REST API.

Network Load Balancer (NLB) hoạt động ở Layer 4 (TCP/UDP/TLS), chịu được hàng triệu RPS với latency cỡ micro giây, static IP hoặc Elastic IP per AZ — quan trọng khi client cần IP cố định (whitelist firewall), preserve source IP; phù hợp cho gaming, IoT, financial trading, TCP-based protocol.

Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) dùng cho deploy, scale và manage third-party virtual appliances (firewalls, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection) — traffic đi qua appliance trước khi đến destination. Cross-zone load balancing: ALB bật mặc định (miễn phí), NLB tắt mặc định (tốn phí nếu bật). Sticky sessions: ALB dùng cookie, NLB dùng 5-tuple hash. Health check: ALB check HTTP status code, NLB check TCP/HTTP. Pricing: ALB tính LCU (Load Balancer Capacity Unit), NLB tính NLCU
answer_en:
ALB for Layer-7 HTTP routing; NLB for Layer-4 high-performance TCP/UDP; GWLB for virtual network appliances.

Application Load Balancer (ALB) operates at Layer 7 (HTTP/HTTPS) and supports content-based routing (by host header, path, query string, HTTP method, headers), WebSocket, HTTP/2, and gRPC; it integrates with Cognito authentication, WAF, and Lambda targets — ideal for web applications, microservices, and REST APIs.

Network Load Balancer (NLB) operates at Layer 4 (TCP/UDP/TLS), handles millions of RPS at microsecond latency, and offers static or Elastic IPs per AZ — important when clients need a fixed IP (firewall whitelisting) and source IP preservation — ideal for gaming, IoT, financial trading, and TCP-based protocols.

Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) is used to deploy, scale, and manage third-party virtual network appliances (firewalls, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection) — traffic passes through the appliance before reaching its destination. Cross-zone load balancing: ALB is enabled by default (free), NLB is disabled by default (costs extra if enabled). Sticky sessions: ALB uses cookies, NLB uses 5-tuple hash. Health checks: ALB checks HTTP status codes, NLB checks TCP/HTTP. Pricing: ALB is billed per LCU (Load Balancer Capacity Unit), NLB per NLCU
